name: PORTFOLIO
description: My flagship 3D developer portfolio — an immersive universe built with Next.js and Three.js showcasing my AI models, engineering projects, and journey.

paragraphs: Welcome to the repository for my immersive 3D interactive portfolio website! I am Teja Priyan, an AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer. I built this experience using Next.js 14, React Three Fiber (Three.js), and Framer Motion to create a cinematic, Apple-inspired scroll-driven journey through my projects, technical skills, AI vision, and background.
features: 🌌 Cinematic 3D WebGL World — Custom Three.js scene rendered with @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei reacting to scroll position and cursor motion.
🤖 Priya Digital AI Assistant — Built-in interactive portfolio guide with quick actions and knowledge about my projects, skills, and background.
🎯 Project Showcases — Interactive tilt cards with direct links to live deployments and GitHub source code.
📊 Animated Skill Arsenal — Animated skill meters categorized across LLMs, Computer Vision, Languages, Frontend, and Backend.
👁️ AI Vision Matrix — Hologram-styled insights highlighting the future of multimodal AI and edge perception.
